summary: Iteration 6 backend testing — 14/14 iter6 tests PASSED + 12/12 iter5 regression PASSED. Verified: (1) Latency P0 — `sources` SSE event arrives well under the 8s budget via parallel HyDE (asyncio.gather of raw + rewritten search) and `done` event no longer waits for the followups LLM call (carries `followups_pending=true` and `suggested_followups=[]`); (2) Lazy followups endpoint POST /api/chat/sessions/{id}/followups returns a list on 1st call, cached=true with identical list on 2nd call (sub-second), 404 on unknown session, and 404 on another user's session (route filters by user_id); (3) Embedding LRU cache — repeated identical query streams cleanly twice with no errors; (4) `tier` field present on every SourceReference (chunks_to_sources stamps it from payload or infers from source); (5) `DocumentSource.REGIONAL_BASE` accepted by /api/documents/upload without 400; (6) Narrow query path with ≤3 candidates does not raise (rerank-skip code path); (7) Full SSE event flow (session→sources→token→done) and CORS preflight intact. seed_global_sources.py importable from /app/backend with GLOBAL_SOURCES length == 19.

minor.issue: Persistent route behaviour from iter5: superadmin uploads are FORCE-mapped to source=base_corpus regardless of the posted `source` form value. This means there is currently NO supported caller path to actually create a doc with source=regional_base — the enum is accepted by the upload form parser but is silently overridden to base_corpus, so resulting chunks land in the base collection with tier=global. Admin role gets force-mapped to source=superadmin (→ tier=company in chunks). Pin tests document this current behaviour. If the diagram-parity 3-tier architecture is meant to be usable end-to-end, the route needs a new role or an explicit superadmin opt-in to keep source=regional_base.

Cross-tenant access returns 404 (because the Mongo find is filtered by `user_id`) rather than 403 — semantically fine (avoids enumeration) but inconsistent with the problem-statement wording which suggested 403. Both 403 and 404 are accepted in the test; behaviour is safe.

action_items: Decide whether REGIONAL_BASE should actually be reachable via /api/documents/upload. Today the route force-overrides any superadmin-posted source to `base_corpus` (document_routes.py:114-117), so the new REGIONAL tier in the 3-tier model has no ingestion path through this endpoint. Either (a) allow superadmin to pass through source∈{base_corpus, regional_base, platform_web} explicitly, or (b) wire regional ingestion through a different path (web_source_routes / seed_global_sources extension) and remove REGIONAL_BASE from the upload form's allowed values to avoid confusion.

Consider returning 403 (not 404) from POST /api/chat/sessions/{id}/followups when the session exists but belongs to another user — current code does a combined `{id, user_id}` find so it always 404s. Today it is safe (no enumeration), but inconsistent with the iter6 spec wording.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: rag_engine.retrieve() does asyncio.gather(raw_search, _hyde_then_search()) with a per-call asyncio.wait_for(timeout=settings.hyde_timeout_s, default 2.5s) — measured sources event well under 8s budget. HyDE timeout fallback path verified does not raise; meta['hyde_timeout']=True can be set on timeout (currently not visible to client unless retrieval_meta exposed in stream).
Good: rag_engine.stream() emits `done` immediately after the token loop with suggested_followups=[] and followups_pending=True. No 5-10s tail.

Good: chat_routes /sessions/{id}/followups is idempotent — re-fetches the last user/assistant pair, returns cached list if already persisted on the message, otherwise calls rag.suggest_followups and persists.
Good: chunks_to_sources stamps `tier` from chunk payload, falling back to _infer_tier_from_source for legacy chunks → backward-compatible.
Good: ingestion.chunk_text() stamps tier (via SOURCE_TO_TIER mapping) and freshness_ts (ISO UTC) on every chunk payload.
Good: embeddings._LRUCache normalises key via lowercased+collapsed-whitespace SHA256 so trivially different cases share a slot; capacity=1000 × 384 floats ≈ 1.5MB is fine.

Bug/Gap: REGIONAL_BASE enum value is unreachable via the upload route (see action_items #1). Either enable an admin role that can keep source=regional_base or remove the value from the upload Form() field. Today this is a usability cliff for the 3-tier story.

Minor: rag_engine.retrieve() applies tier boost (company 1.20×, regional 1.05×, global 1.0×) BEFORE the jurisdiction boost (×1.15 / ×0.85). Compounded, a company+matching-jurisdiction chunk gets 1.20×1.15=1.38× while a global+other-jurisdiction chunk gets 0.85×. That gap may be larger than intended on edge cases; consider clamping or applying only one of the boosts when both fire.

Minor: chat_routes followups endpoint uses chat_messages_col().find(...).sort('created_at', -1).limit(2) — relies on created_at lexicographic ordering. Works because _now_iso() returns ISO timestamps, but if any code path ever writes a different shape this becomes silently wrong. Consider sorting by an integer monotonic field or by _id.

Minor: meta['rerank_skipped'] is set inside retrieve() but is not surfaced through the stream's `sources` event (retrieval_meta is only carried on the sources event payload via chat_routes line 181). If observability of skip-rerank is desired, expose it.
Minor: rag_engine.retrieve()'s _hyde_then_search returns [] on TimeoutError but does NOT cancel the in-flight task — relies on the wait_for cancellation. Verified working but worth a comment.
